meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with who decided my son gets a zero, and why I found out from his phone and not from you.
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

A machine's guess, then. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish anything, and the company that sells these tools says the same in print; I have it in my bag. Was Owen even spoken to before you entered that zero?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My child never lies, Hale, and "very reliable" is an adjective, not evidence. I'm writing down that you just called him a cheater with nothing but a percentage behind it. Answer my question: did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in?
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening his record because his mother asked a question. Your own procedure says a first concern goes to a supervised reassessment and nothing goes on file, so I'm writing that threat down word for word. I'll be in the principal's office before my call unless you withdraw the zero now.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that the zero on Owen's essay be withdrawn, that I receive an apology, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, having agreed to nothing and heading to the principal.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "your son cheated", because it attacked Owen with only a detector score behind it, and the threat about his "permanent record" made it worse.
Try next time: in your first line, instead of the 94% score, own that the zero went in before anyone called home, then show her one dated document tied to Owen's own work that she can read herself.
